activities.instructions: Desliza a la derecha si la frase es correcta y a la izquierda si no lo es.
activities.prompt: Mazo de 8 afirmaciones para repasar el tema.

cards.statement: I was reading when the phone was ringing.
I was reading when the phone rang.
cards.explanation: El fondo usa past continuous; la interrupción past simple.

cards.statement: While they were eating, the lights went out.
cards.explanation: El fondo con «while» usa past continuous.

cards.statement: He locked the door and left.
cards.explanation: El evento principal usa past simple.

cards.statement: He had finished the report by noon.
cards.explanation: El evento anterior usa past perfect.

cards.statement: They had been waiting for an hour.
cards.explanation: La duración anterior usa past perfect continuous.

cards.statement: The sun was setting as we arrived.
She had been knowing him for years.

activities.explanation: Cada carta repasa una regla del tema; revisa las falladas al terminar el mazo.
